description: Defines an immutable class ImmutableFeatureDefinitionIdentifier implementing the interface DefinitionIdentifier, representing a unique identifier for feature definitions with methods for creation, parsing, and property access.

classes.name: ImmutableFeatureDefinitionIdentifier
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the DefinitionIdentifier interface, representing a feature definition identifier with methods for creation, parsing, and property access.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates a new ImmutableFeatureDefinitionIdentifier with specified namespace, name, and version.

methods.name: ofParsed
methods.description: Parses a CharSequence to create an ImmutableFeatureDefinitionIdentifier, or returns it if already of that type.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace part of the identifier.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name part of the identifier.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version part of the identifier.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the delegate identifier.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns hash code based on the delegate identifier.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the delegate identifier.

methods.name: charAt
methods.description: Returns the character at the specified index in the delegate identifier.

methods.name: subSequence
methods.description: Returns a subsequence of the delegate identifier.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the delegate identifier.
